target_phenotype: Morphological cell phenotype — nuclear shape, texture, and chromatin-mark intensity features across 5 imaging channels (DNA + histone modifications)

readout.measurement: High-content fluorescence imaging of fixed cells
readout.instrument_or_platform: Optical pooled screening (in situ sequencing + imaging)
readout.primary_metric: Morphological feature vectors — genes are clustered by similarity of phenotypic profiles across imaging channels

clustering.method: Leiden clustering on PHATE-embedded phenotypic profiles

notes: Chromatin/histone-mark screen. Channels read out DNA plus four histone modifications (H3K4me3, H3K27ac, H3K9me3, H4Kac-me). Clusters represent sets of genes whose knockout produces similar chromatin-morphology phenotypes.
